column3: He did not want to admit that he made a mistake at work. (他不想承認自己在工作上犯了錯。)
She scored very high on her English speaking test yesterday. (她昨天的英語口說測驗拿了很高的分數。)

column2: adj. 年度的；一年一度的
column3: Our company holds an annual meeting for all staff in December. (我們公司在十二月會為全體員工舉辦年度會議。)
The event organizers sent an email with the new schedule. (活動主辦方寄出了一封附有新日程表的電子郵件。)
The team shared preliminary results before the final report was ready. (團隊在最終報告準備好之前分享了初步結果。)
A power failure caused the office computers to shut down. (電力故障導致辦公室電腦全部關機。)
Two cars collided at the busy intersection this morning. (今天早上有兩輛車在繁忙的十字路口相撞了。)
Local residents rallied to protect the old library in town. (當地居民聚集起來保護鎮上的老圖書館。)
The new community center needs more funding to finish construction. (新社區中心需要更多資金來完成建設。)
My manager insisted that we check every contract carefully. (我的經理堅持要求我們仔細檢查每一份合約。)
The driver wore a seatbelt and avoided a fatal injury. (駕駛繫了安全帶，因而避開了致命傷害。)
The judge will sentence the thief tomorrow morning. (法官將在明天上午對該竊賊進行宣判。)
He injured his shoulder while moving heavy boxes into the house. (他把重箱子搬進屋子時弄傷了肩膀。)
You must show your passport when you cross the national border. (跨越國界時，你必須出示護照。)
I suspect that our flight will be delayed because of the storm. (我猜想我們的航班可能會因為暴風雨而延誤。)
This local factory manufactures electronic parts for mobile phones. (這家在地工廠專門生產手機用電子零件。)
The strong wind caused severe damage to the hotel roof. (強風對飯店屋頂造成了嚴重的損害。)
